method: Web product category, so no review feed. (1) trustmrr tools: one discover_startups call (no key needed) and one list_startups call (category design-tools, limit 10, default revenue-desc sort); both worked. The category filter also returned some non-Design-Tools products, which were ignored. (2) WebSearch, 7 standard queries about Canva, AI logo makers, vector/SVG export and background removal. (3) WebFetch was BLOCKED: all 3 attempts (Trustpilot Canva page, a Gamma ideas page, a HubSpot article) failed with 'proxy refused the connection', so no page was opened directly and nothing here comes from a fetched page. (4) Important limit: WebSearch here returns a written summary plus a link list, not raw result snippets with dates. Complaint quotes below are only strings that appeared in quotation marks or parentheses inside that search output, and are copied exactly. The search output did not give a per-review date, so every complaint has date null and a date_note; the result page titles say '2026' for Capterra and G2. Some quotes are fragments. Evidence is thin. No Reddit, no logins. Complaints about price, paywalls and billing were seen in large numbers (Canva Trustpilot summaries) and were left out as not capability gaps.
